plant.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single isolated indoor monstera/philodendron houseplant for a cosy pixel RPG office, matching the reference furniture's crisp pixel clusters, subtle dark outlines, warm light from the bottom/front, restrained illustrated shading, and overhead three-quarter camera. Big broad glossy deep green leaves with natural splits, a few lighter sage new leaves, branching stems, planted in a squat square warm terracotta pot. Full object visible, no cast shadow or floor, genuine transparent background, no text. Compact readable silhouette, meant to export at 50x66 native pixels. Detailed painted-pixel quality matching the reference sofa and desk; no photorealism, no vector-flat shapes.
